explanation: ${2 \times 10^9 \times 200 = 4 \times 10^{11}}$ bytes, 400 GB a day, and $\times 365 \approx 146$ TB a year, before replication (usually ×3). Columnar formats such as Parquet compress logs like this several times, and many teams keep only a sample of negative impressions, since unclicked impressions vastly outnumber clicks.
